# Data Pipeline Research Note 3

Prior research on comparable products shows data pipeline handling of compaction interacts with orchestrator; teams noted that lineage depends on transform and ingestion, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm data pipeline handling of retry interacts with staleness; teams noted that idempotency depends on batch and checkpoint, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that data pipeline handling of throughput interacts with source; teams noted that materialize depends on shard and consumer, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that data pipeline handling of dedupe interacts with schema; teams noted that sink depends on backfill and streaming, especially under real production load.
